description: Fig. 16 is a single-panel composition-space phase-field map for Fe-Mn-Al-C steels, plotting carbon content C (wt%) on the y-axis (0.0–1.6, ticks every 0.2) against aluminium content Al (wt%) on the x-axis (0–12, ticks every 2). Four phase fields are labelled: γ (upper left), γ+α (lower centre), γ+κ (upper right) and γ+κ+α (lower right). Experimental alloy compositions are marked as open circles (γ field), solid squares (γ+κ) and solid diamonds (γ+α+κ); the open circles cluster at Al ≈ 2–5.5 wt%, the solid squares at Al ≈ 7–10.5 wt% reaching C ≈ 1.3 wt%, and the solid diamonds at Al ≈ 8–12 wt%. Three steep, near-parallel solid lines labelled 30Mn, 20Mn and 15Mn from left to right act as κ formation boundaries; two diagonal dashed boundaries, a black one labelled 15Mn and a blue one labelled 30Mn, cross the lower half of the plot. The figure demonstrates that intragranular κ-carbide precipitation requires sufficiently high Al and C contents, with the Mn level shifting the formation boundary.

subfigures.description: A scatter/phase-field map of C (wt%) vs Al (wt%) with four labelled phase fields (γ, γ+α, γ+κ, γ+κ+α), three experimental data-point series (open circles, solid squares, solid diamonds), three steep solid Mn-labelled κ formation boundaries (15Mn, 20Mn, 30Mn) and two diagonal dashed boundaries (black 15Mn, blue 30Mn).

observations.observation: The y-axis is C (wt%) spanning 0.0–1.6 with ticks every 0.2; the x-axis is Al (wt%) spanning 0–12 with ticks every 2.
Four phase fields are labelled in the plot: γ (upper left), γ+α (lower centre), γ+κ (upper right) and γ+κ+α (lower right).
Open-circle data points lie in the γ field, clustered at Al ≈ 2–5.5 wt% with C from about 0.4 to 1.05 wt%.
Solid-square data points lie in the γ+κ field, mostly at Al ≈ 7–10.5 wt% with C up to about 1.3 wt%, with a few squares at lower C.
Solid-diamond data points lie in the γ+κ+α field at Al ≈ 8–12 wt% and C ≈ 0.4–1.05 wt%.
Three steep, near-parallel solid lines are labelled 30Mn, 20Mn and 15Mn from left to right and separate the γ field from the κ-bearing fields.
Two dashed boundaries run diagonally across the lower half of the plot: a black line labelled 15Mn and a blue line labelled 30Mn.
The caption states that the open circle, solid square and solid diamond indicate experimental alloy compositions located in the γ, (γ+κ) and (γ+α+κ) phase fields, respectively [8,120,127].
The caption states that the solid lines are the κ formation boundaries predicted by Eq. (3) given in Huang et al. [127].
The citing text states that approximately Al > 7% and C > 0.7% are necessary to introduce intragranular κ-carbides in a fully austenitic Fe-Mn-Al-C steel.
